Andy, a couple of months ago I studies PAZs extensively... However, I
have not been able to incorporate them in my trading yet...

but, from what I have learned I can tell that:

1 Compression is a PAZ

2 Stacked demand / supply area in itself is a PAZ

3 space between FTRs is a PAZ

4 space between 2 PAZ's is a PAZ

author: Les_Paul
text:
So my personal EURECA moment is something which has been repeated here
 many times by IF and other kind teachers. I am 100% sure that all of
you have heard this and many of you have already incorporated this basic
 truth in your trading. I finaly realised this only after countless
hours spent with Forex Tester. I asked myself a question:

How is it, George, that you can rock in Forex TEster (see my fancy PL
curve in one of above posts) but you rather suck in live trading?

And the Almighty gave me the answer: It is because in Forex Tester you need to wait for the ideal setup only a couple of minutes but in real life you often have to wait a couple of days...
 (I am sure that you are aware of the function in FT that you can FAST
FORWARD the market, so for example one week in H4 TF lasts only a couple
 of minutes).

In real life I am very impatient (I have been working on this issue of
mine for a couple of years now and must admit that I have made a
substantial progress, but still, I am far from ideal state), so I hardly
 ever wait for a proper setup...

SO, the answer to my personal struggle is: ALWAYS WAIT FOR THE PRICE ACTION TO SHOW YOU THE WAY (universal RTM rule),

and ALWAYS WAIT FOR YOUR SWEET FTR!!!!! (my personal extremely englightening rule)

I hope I haven't disappointed you very much - I know it's nothing new, but for me it is a huge leap forward....

Les_Paul
